observation.visible_scene: A single glowing lamp fixture—trapezoidal white shade topped by an orange halo—sits slightly right of center against an otherwise black night background. A small dim red dot near the left edge and a few faint specks near the top remain fixed in place throughout.
visible_changes: The lamp holds the same position, shape, and brightness in every frame; there is no pan, zoom, or object translation of the lamp itself.

Faint vertical streaks and specks appear, shift, and vanish in the dim region directly below the lamp, consistent with illuminated falling droplets (or sensor/compression noise) rather than the lamp moving.
The fixed red dot and top specks do not move relative to the lamp, indicating the camera is essentially stationary.
No onset, stop, contact, or completion is visible; the lit state is continuous across the whole excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the streaks below the lamp are rain or artifact, the lamp's mounting and surrounding environment, and any change in illumination before or after this window.
uncertain_details: The exact cause and nature of the faint moving streaks beneath the lamp; possible very slight flicker in the orange glow versus constant brightness.
